items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: Joe Williams got sick and he’s not going to be able to make it.

ctx.x: And we said, yeah, sure, why not? We’re here. Okay. And he says, “oh thank you, you saved our lives, because Joe Williams got sick and he’s not going to be able to make it.” So that was it. And then Jackie said why not, for Marian’s 80th birthday, let’s sing that song of hers that she wrote with Peggy Lee. What’s it called?
“In the Days of Our Love,” which is pretty.
